name: cook-it
description: Cook step by step, scale servings, and organize recipes in Google Docs.

interface.longDescription: Cook from a recipe you provide or find a meal from the ingredients you have. Cook-It guides you one step at a time, answers questions without advancing, and scales servings. With Google Drive connected and recipe write tools available, it can save recipes as Google Docs and find them by category, tags, or ingredients.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through making tortilla de patatas for four, one step at a time.
I have eggs, potatoes and onions. What can I cook?
Save this recipe to my Google Docs cookbook and tag it for easy searching.
